title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Handling Civil and Commercial Dispute Cases Involving the Sixth Batch of Canceled or Restructured Trust Investment Companies
keywords_en: Civil and commercial disputes involving securities and trust investment companies
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Disposal of Civil and Commercial Dispute Cases Involving the Sixth Batch of Trust Investment Companies Undergoing Dissolution or Restructuring

Fa [2001] No. 111

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To assist the State Council in the work of reorganizing and rectifying trust investment companies, this Court has previously published five batches of lists of trust investment companies undergoing reorganization and rectification, as well as opinions on the handling of related civil and commercial dispute cases. Now, the sixth batch of the list of trust investment companies undergoing reorganization and rectification is hereby published (the list is attached). The relevant issues are notified as follows:

For civil and commercial dispute cases in which the trust investment companies listed in the attached list, as well as their branches, offices, and operating securities business departments, are named as defendants, acceptance shall still be temporarily suspended or enforcement shall be stayed in accordance with the spirit of the previously issued notices. The period for such temporary suspension of acceptance or stay of enforcement shall extend to February 6, 2002.

If any special circumstances or problems arise during implementation, please promptly report to this Court for coordination and resolution.

August 21, 2001
